mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.note_id AS noteId, c.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, ru.username AS replyToUsername, c.reply_to_comment_id AS replyToCommentId, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM t_comment c LEFT JOIN t_user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_user ru ON c.reply_to_user_id = ru.id WHERE c.note_id = #{noteId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
